fact: SAWS states it maintains weather satellite equipment at multiple sites to receive Meteosat Second Generation data, has struggled with reception since 5G arrived in 2020, and is procuring C-band 5G LNBs and bandpass filters for its MSG receivers.
title: RFQ 3551/24 Supply and delivery of C-Band 5G LNB's with compatible Bandpass filters for Weather Satellite MSG receivers
